iced_latte: Hot day today! People will want iced drinks. Let me show you the Iced Latte.
Take a plastic cup from the stack left of the machine and drop it on the ice bin in the fridge. Pull the shot into it, then pour cold milk straight from the fridge. Don't steam it!
cappuccino: New on the menu: Cappuccino. It's a latte with much more foam.
Keep the pitcher low under the steam wand for longer, so the froth marker reaches the higher green zone. Cocoa on top at the topping station.
iced_gula_melaka_latte: New on the menu: Iced Gula Melaka Latte. Very Malaysian, very popular.
Make an iced latte, then add 2 pumps of gula melaka at the topping station.
mocha: Mocha is on the menu now: coffee meets chocolate.
Make a latte, then add 2 pumps of chocolate and a swirl of whipped cream.
kopi_susu_ais: Our own Kopi Susu Ais, kopitiam style! Customers will love this one.
Ice in a plastic cup, a double espresso, then 2 pumps of condensed milk. No fresh milk at all.
caramel_macchiato: Last one for now: Caramel Macchiato.
A latte with 1 pump of vanilla and 2 pumps of caramel. Sweet tooth special!
